dedupe_keys.name: epa agstar livestock anaerobic digester database

description: A database of anaerobic digester projects on US livestock farms. The EPA page says the database gives key information on digester projects on livestock farms, accessible through a map, a table or a downloadable Excel file free of charge, and that AgSTAR updates it periodically, generally twice a year, from voluntary sources, so accuracy is not guaranteed and not every project is included; a combined copy is also posted on Kaggle. Coverage is the United States. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): Public domain (EPA web policy: EPA-produced data are in the public domain unless otherwise specified). For simulation it places on-farm biogas plants that supply renewable gas and electricity and depend on livestock operations, for energy and agriculture interdependency and hazard exposure studies. A related catalogue record is the EPA greenhouse gas reporting program.
